limits: Existing32 tests are isolated synthetic contracts, not proof of a real release or repository permission grant.

planned_workflow.attempt_guard: Require GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT == 1 before invoking publisher; a rerun cannot resume publication
planned_workflow.branch_changes: Only Root creates the later publication workflow commit/ref update; active candidate PR485, its source, native pin, runtime jobs and verifier remain untouched.
planned_workflow.budget_rationale: The CLI checks a strict 3600-second decision budget, not a hard total process duration. One in-flight verifier can run up to 900 seconds, HTTP operations accept no response after 600 seconds, and full-byte I/O remains work. An independent 80-minute step limit and 100-minute job limit provide a finite outer boundary plus setup/evidence headroom; neither extends the CLI limits. Timeout remains failure with possibly unknown remote outcome.

candidate_checkout.preflight: Exact expected host/tree; all five required committed bytes; unchanged verifier/helper hashes; clean status and raw index/stage binding

evidence_upload.artifact_name: lumo-c4-publication-originals-<actual publisher run id>-<actual publisher attempt>
evidence_upload.contents: Complete original delivery ZIP, every extracted immutable member, exact API observations, all verifier stdio/results, publication-step stdio/result or interrupted marker, source/index stamps, public downloaded APK and verification receipt or failure.json. No checkout/token/private URL file included.

planned_workflow.failure_behavior: No continue-on-error, rerun, resume, clobber, delete, cleanup mutation or retry of writes. Preserve partial originals; Root must inspect any uncertain tag/draft/published outcome. Always steps cannot guarantee persistence after runner loss or hard job cancellation.
planned_workflow.new_tests: None in this plan. Existing32 isolated test proof is retained; no live mutation has been exercised.
planned_workflow.path_layout: Two sibling checkouts under GITHUB_WORKSPACE; all evidence, stdio, temporary paths and optional pycache remain under RUNNER_TEMP outside both. No nested checkout or generated root artifact.
planned_workflow.publication_invocation: Exactly one argv-list call whose script element is str(Path(publisher_source).resolve(strict=True) / "scripts/publish_connect_four_delivery.py"). The identical absolute publisher_source value is passed to --publisher-source. The external RUNNER_TEMP evidence CWD is unchanged. Only after all missing bundle fields are observed may Root render exact candidate/bundle arguments into the new workflow. No CLI/verifier changes.

publisher_checkout.preflight: Compare publisher CLI byte hash and blob to exact72143 source before the token-bearing invocation; bind the actual new workflow commit rather than pretending its HEAD is72143

planned_workflow.stream_capture: Create evidence parent and STARTED marker before invocation. Preserve stdout and stderr separately; record actual child return code when available. If runner/step interruption prevents wait completion, record UNKNOWN/INTERRUPTED instead of fabricating a child exit. Do not tee credentials or dump environment.
planned_workflow.success_definition: Actual CLI exit0 plus completed.json status PUBLIC_BYTES_VERIFIED and exact public-verification receipt. A published release without verified public bytes remains a failed/incomplete publication proof.
planned_workflow.tooling: Existing python3 >=3.11 and git, record exact versions; source was actually tested with Python3.12.14. No pip, Flutter, Godot, Android SDK, Java, FFmpeg or package-resolution step is needed for publication.
